title: PRB Agriculture Professional-Background Priority Map
disclaimer: This is a study-weighting aid only. Public professional backgrounds do not prove which person writes a given examination item and do not guarantee that a topic will appear. The current PRC Table of Specifications and the learner's mock-exam error pattern remain higher-priority signals.
strategyOrder: 1. Sir Brian mock-exam mistakes and weak competencies
2. Current PRC Enhanced Tables of Specifications
3. Publicly documented PRB professional specializations and research/practice backgrounds
4. Recurrent themes from legacy reviewers and recalled prior-exam topics

members.name: Emma K. Sales
members.documentedBackground: Retired University of Southern Mindanao professor; recognized for crop biotechnology; established a tissue culture and biotechnology laboratory; developed molecular diagnostic/identification tools for durian, rubber and mango varieties.
priorityThemes: rubber, durian and mango crop science

members.name: Eric P. Palacpac
members.documentedBackground: BS and MS in Animal Science, with animal production/dairy background; PhD work on science-society interface; Philippine Carabao Center knowledge-management and operations-research leadership; research interests include livestock innovations, technology transfer, science communication, extension, evaluation, ruminant production/nutrition and dairy technology.

members.name: Annabelle S. Sarabia
members.documentedBackground: PhD and MS in Animal Science major in Animal Physiology; former Philippine Carabao Center senior manager/researcher; research interests include animal physiology, reproduction, pregnancy diagnosis, artificial insemination, embryo transfer, ovarian examination, estrus synchronization, superovulation, livestock production and management.

members.name: Maria Eden S. Piadozo
members.documentedBackground: UPLB agricultural economist; former chair of the Department of Agricultural and Applied Economics; specialization in Agricultural Economics, Agricultural Marketing and International Trade; research includes market integration, price linkages, marketing channels and organic certification economics.

members.name: Lilia A. Portales
members.documentedBackground: Former senior agriculturist with the Bureau of Plant Industry Crop Protection Division; professional involvement in the Philippine Phytopathological Society, including leadership roles.

members.name: Anastacia G. Notarte
members.documentedBackground: Long-serving provincial agriculturist in Davao del Norte and agricultural/fishery council leader. Public sources strongly document applied agricultural administration, local program implementation and farmer/stakeholder coordination, but do not clearly establish a single narrow academic specialization.
priorityThemes: applied farm and provincial agriculture scenarios
